name: WingArc1st Inc.
summary: WingArc1st Inc. provides software and services in Japan. The company offers SVF products for form design and form output that comprises Form Design, which defines the layout of forms and creates form files; Interface, which connects host systems and the output engine that acts as the main body of SVF; and Form Output, which is the engine that combines form definitions and analyzed data to output forms. It also provides SVF Cloud, a cloud form service; document management platforms, including invoiceAgent documents document management solution and invoiceAgent AI OCR form digitization solution; and Dr.Sum, a data analysis platform for integrating and utilizing data.
